g.text: HUMAN FACTORS FORENSICS: THE BIOLOGY OF THE STRESSED RETINA VS. COMMODITY TYPE
203 DPI THERMAL BLEED & SCOTOPIC DEFOCUS (0.05 mcg FENTANYL)
Period advance is only 48 UPM with zero optical isolation. On thermal bedside wristbands or low-res pumps, ink bridging swallows the decimal point entirely.
Period advance 324 UPM with 149 UPM optical clearance buffer. High-visibility period diameter prevents dot occlusion under 203 DPI thermal bleed.
Louise Sloan 5:1 Acuity • Guaranteed Period Side-Bearing ≥ 120 UPM
CIRCADIAN RETINAL FATIGUE AT 04:00 AM (FOVEAL SEARCH LOSS)
✕ COMMODITY GROTESQUE: THREE IDENTICAL VERTICAL BARS
Identical vertical stems. Numeral 0 and capital letter O share identical outer perimeter. Under astigmatism or 45° off-axis tilt, characters collapse.
Numeral 1 has a distinct head serif; lowercase l has an outbound curved terminal (cv05); capital I features bilobe serifs (ss02); zero is internally slashed (cv08).
Zero Saccadic Collisions • Asymmetric Stroke Recognition Architecture
ISMP TALL MAN ARCHITECTURE & STEM WEIGHT HARMONY
Commodity caps jump in stem thickness from 68 UPM to 112 UPM, causing optical visual staggering that triggers fixation stumbles during emergency prep.
PocketGull harmonizes cap stem weights to exactly match the 68 UPM baseline metric. True optical height balance allows immediate, unstumbled discrimination.
Fatal Intrathecal Prevention Protocol • Unified 1000 UPM Em-Square
4. The 1,000x Unit Gap: mcg vs. mg & Titration
OPEN APERTURE PRESERVATION UNDER 45° OFF-AXIS VIEWING
Curved terminals curl tightly inward. Under distance, astigmatism, or poor viewing angles, 'c' bridges into 'o' or blurs against 'm', causing a fatal 1,000x dosage jump.
Wide 45-degree angled terminals maximize interior negative space. 'c', 'e', and 'm' remain radically distinct across off-axis angles and dirty monitor shields.
Maximal Photoreceptor Separation • Tabular Figure Alignment ('tnum')
